title: Bias Beneath the Tone: Empirical Characterisation of Tone Bias in LLM-Driven UX Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on empirical characterization of linguistic 'tone bias' (such as being overly polite or cheerful) in LLM-generated responses. While it mentions 'ethical emotion recognition' and fairness in the context of user experience, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, morals, or ethical frameworks.
